text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh. Droite... date... an invitation. 
Hnnnnnnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you alright, Bakushin O? Um... this 
is about your drawers, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowa?! How did you know that?! ...Though, 
you are entirely correct!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How on earth am I supposed to schedule 
this date?! ...I mean, there are just so 
many of them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Neh? There are too many people...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I'm also worried about the 
dance. ...There's nowhere near enough time 
to dance with everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Error detected. Several events appear 
to be contradictory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! ...Well, it can't be 
helped. At times like this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin! Atchoooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! Not yet, not yet, not yet! 
Bakushin, Bakushin! Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Bakushin O-senpai is crazy fast! 
Truly lightning-speed.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing...! Just watching gets me 
so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You there! What did you just say?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-I was just thinking how amazing 
Bakushin O-senpai is~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It happened right after that!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What else!? Um, um... J-Just looking at 
all this gets me so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Humph! —All set!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Bakushin O, where's your "date"? 
...Could it be she hasn't shown up yet?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No! They are already here! After all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My "date" is with everyone in this venue! 
Every single one of you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh?

text_block_list.name: Droite Participants
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaaaaaat!? E-Everyone!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Bourbon-san said so last year! She 
said the condition for a date is 'to grant 
the target unparalleled exhilaration'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I looked it up in the dictionary! 
'Exhilaration' basically means 'thrilling 
excitement'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And! Having mastered "maximum speed"! I am 
a presence that thrills everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! An essential for 
absolutely anyone! —An ultra-exemplary 
"date"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And with that! Let's show everyone my 
date!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just watching it makes your heart race! A 
quintessential, textbook speed dance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Though we cannot dance together in person— 
I shall carry your heart with me!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —*gasp*...! —Astonishing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sooo cool...! Whoa! Her legs are moving 
like swooosh-swooosh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Spinning 'round and 'round... that's 
amazing! And what's more, she's 
accelerating...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Continuous acceleration 
detected in both turns and steps. And...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Acquired status: 'Excitement.' Just 
what was that speed...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Umamusume can really run... 
that fast. So fast... like the wind...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Flight-san! You came!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Your performance was absolutely 
wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still...—with me by your side, you can 
become even more wonderful.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Someday, I want to be your 'date.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I won't make a reservation... I'll make 
them choose me. —With my speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then I shall wait! ...For the day 
your reach finally catches up to mine!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Standing on the turf with you, beyond 
that, giving you "unrivaled elation".

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So... please wait for me. Just a little 
longer—I'll catch up to you soon!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It might still be difficult right now. But 
someday, surely...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“With my speed, I'll whisk you away to a 
brand new runway♪”
